title: Smart Data Models - GS1 Web Vocabulary - Place
description: Entities that have a somewhat fixed, physical location. (GS1 Web Vocabulary 1.18 class gs1:Place. Property names verbatim.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Place'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

additionalLocationID.description: Property. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/additionalLocationID'. Location identifiers assigned and managed by government bodies, trade organisations, and other entities.

baseLocation.description: Relationship. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/baseLocation'. A fixed physical location where a mobile location most commonly resides. If gs1:glnType is present, gs1:baseLocationGLN SHALL only be used when gs1:glnType is gs1:GLN_TypeCode-MOBILE_PHYSICAL_LOCATION Points to Place entities.

containedInPlace.description: Relationship. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/containedInPlace'. Designates the larger physical location a sub-location is located within. To specify sub-locations of a physical location, see gs1:containsPlace. Points to Place entities.

containsPlace.description: Relationship. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/containsPlace'. Designates a sub-location (e.g., floor, room, shelf) within the physical location being identified. There may be multiple sub-locations associated to a single, physical location. To specify the larger physical location the sub-location is located within, see gs1:containedInPlace Points to Place entities.

digitalAddress.description: Property. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/digitalAddress'. The location reference associated to a digital place. If gs1:glnType is present, SHALL only be associated if the value of gs1:glnType is gs1:GLN_TypeCode-DIGITAL_LOCATION.

digitalLocationName.description: Property. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/digitalLocationName'. The name of a digital place. To specify the name of a physical location, see gs1:physicalLocationName.

geo.description: Property. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/geo'. Links to information about geocoordinates or geoshapes for a place.

leasedFrom.description: Relationship. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/leasedFrom'. Links to the organisation (lessor) from which this place is leased. Points to Organization entities.

leasedTo.description: Relationship. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/leasedTo'. Links to the organisation(s) (lessee(s)) to which this place is leased. Property SHOULD be applied to a specific sub-location, rather than a main location, wherever possible. Points to Organization entities.

locationDescription.description: Property. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/locationDescription'. The description of a place.

locationFinalClosureDate.description: Property. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/locationFinalClosureDate'. Date in which a location was finally closed. Note that this is NOT the date when a GLN was deactivated. To designate when location opened, see gs1:locationOpeningDate.

locationGLN.description: Property. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/locationGLN'. 13-digit GLN that is being used to identify a physical or digital location. If gs1:glnType is present, gs1:locationGLN SHALL only be used when gs1:GLN_TypeCode includes FIXED_PHYSICAL_LOCATION, MOBILE_PHYSICAL_LOCATION, or DIGITAL_LOCATION

locationHistory.description: Property. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/locationHistory'. Provides details on if and when a location is active or inactive.

locationOpeningDate.description: Property. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/locationOpeningDate'. Date in which a location was opened or otherwise established. Note that this is NOT the date when a GLN was allocated to identify the location. To designate when location was finally closed, see gs1: gs1:locationFinalClosureDate

locationRole.description: Property. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/locationRole'. A location classification based on the purpose, type of site and/or what occurs there. Repeatable value from gs1:LocationRoleType code list. Values are GS1 code-list members as compact IRIs (gs1:<Code>); deprecated codes are left out.

managedFor.description: Relationship. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/managedFor'. Links to the organisation(s) for whom this place is managed. Property SHOULD be applied to a specific sub-location, rather than a main location, wherever possible. Points to Organization entities.

occupiedBy.description: Relationship. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/occupiedBy'. Links to the organisation(s) that occupy this place. Property SHOULD be applied to a specific sub-location, rather than a main location, wherever possible. Points to Organization entities.

physicalLocationName.description: Property. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/physicalLocationName'. The name of a physical place. To specify the name of a digital location, see gs1:digitalLocationName.

primaryLocationOf.description: Relationship. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/primaryLocationOf'. Links to the organisation(s) that designate this place as its/their primary location. Property SHOULD be applied to a specific sub-location, rather than a main location, wherever possible. Points to Organization entities.

relatedOrganization.description: Relationship. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/relatedOrganization'. The organisation(s) associated with a place. Points to Organization entities.

replacedByPlace.description: Relationship. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/replacedByPlace'. Links to the successor location that is used in place of a previous location Points to Place entities.

replacedPlace.description: Relationship. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/replacedPlace'. Links to the previous location that this location replaces Points to Place entities.

responsibleOrganization.description: Relationship. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/responsibleOrganization'. Links to the organisation that is directly responsible for this place. Points to Organization entities.

siteAccessRequirements.description: Property. Model:'https://ref.gs1.org/voc/siteAccessRequirements'. A URI value linking to information related to requirements for accessing or visiting a place.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. Not a GS1 property (Smart Data Models addition): GeoJSON Point built from the GS1 geo (GeoCoordinates latitude/longitude) so that NGSI-LD geo-queries work.

coordinateReferenceSystem.description: Open standard spatial reference systems or coordinate reference systems that provide coordinate-based local, regional or global system used to locate geographical entities. Values should be URIs already defined by the IOPG Geomatics Committee (https://epsg.org/), such as https://epsg.io/4326 (WGS84); https://epsg.io/4267 (NAD27); https://epsg.io/4230 (ED50); https://epsg.io/4618 (SAD69); https://epsg.io/4269 (NAD83). For elevation values, gs1:elevation SHALL be used.

elevation.description: The elevation of a location (WGS 84). Values may be of the form 'NUMBER UNITOFMEASUREMENT' (e.g., '1,000 m', '3,200 ft') while numbers alone SHALL be a value in meters.

latitude.description: Angular distance North or South from the earth's equator measured through 90 degrees.

longitude.description: The arc or portion of the earth's equator intersected between the meridian of a given place and the prime meridian and expressed in degrees

circle.description: A circle is the circular region of a specified radius centred at a specified latitude and longitude. A circle is expressed as a pair followed by a radius in meters.

line.description: A line is a point-to-point path consisting of two or more point objects separated by a space. A single line segment (i.e., straight line) is expressed as two points. A multi-line path (i.e., open polygon) is expressed as a series of three or more points. For a closed shape, gs1:polygon SHALL be used.

polygon.description: A polygon is the area enclosed by a point-to-point path for which the starting and ending points are the same. A polygon is expressed as a series of four or more space delimited points where the first and final points are identical.

locationID.description: Identifier value associated to a location. This value SHALL follow rules set forth by the administrating organisation designated in gs1:LocationID_Type.

locationID_Qualifier.description: Secondary qualifier to supplement gs1:LocationID_Type meaning. May be used with proprietary ID code values to define identifier administrator.

locationID_Type.description: Organisation that administers the gs1:locationID or the name of the ID itself. Value from gs1:LocationID_Type code list.

locationID_URI.description: A URI that links to information about the gs1:locationID.

LocationID_Type.description: GS1 code list LocationID_Type: members as compact IRIs gs1:<Code> (deprecated codes left out).

LocationRoleType.description: GS1 code list LocationRoleType: members as compact IRIs gs1:<Code> (deprecated codes left out).

locationStatus.description: Designation of active/inactive status of a location.

StatusType.description: GS1 code list StatusType: members as compact IRIs gs1:<Code> (deprecated codes left out).
